claims.claim: Ian Garry is a tall fighter with great jiu-jitsu and striking.
claims.quote: Ian's a tall guy, he's got great jiu-jitsu, he's got great striking.

claims.claim: Islam Makhachev is currently unstoppable in his division.
claims.quote: I don't see anybody who can stop him right now in this division.

claims.claim: Ian Garry is talented and skillful enough to surprise people in the fight.
claims.quote: I think Ian is going to surprise a lot of people with how talented he is and how skillful he is.

claims.claim: Ian Garry can frustrate Islam Makhachev and catch him if he maintains distance.
claims.quote: If he can maintain that distance against Islam, um I think he can kind of frustrate him and really catch him in the in the fight as well

claims.claim: Islam Makhachev is bigger, stronger, has more power, and will take Ian Garry down to hold and submit him.
claims.quote: Makhachev is bigger and he's he he stronger and like he got more power and he can he going to take him down and hold him and submit him

claims.claim: Islam Makhachev is too dominant, leaving Ian Garry with few options to win.
claims.quote: He's just so dominant. I I don't see Ian having a lot of options to winning that one.

claims.claim: Islam Makhachev has almost no flaws in his game.
claims.quote: I don't see many flaws, you know, I I I almost no no flaw in his game

claims.claim: Ian Garry's only loss came against a tough grappler in Shavkat.
claims.quote: one of the only loss that Ian Garry has has been against a real tough grappler when he fought Shavkat.

claims.claim: Ian Garry has a striking and reach advantage going into the fight against Islam Makhachev.
claims.quote: Ian Garry may have an advantage in the striking um in the rage department going against the going into this fight against Islam.

claims.claim: Islam Makhachev does very well in the pocket and can close distance effectively.
claims.quote: Islam does very good in the pocket, does very good he's able to close distance

claims.claim: Ian Garry fights very well, smartly, and impressively.
claims.quote: I think Ian Garry just like fights so well, so smart, and he's very impressive

claims.claim: Ian Garry keeps his distance very well and is dangerous on the feet.
claims.quote: he keeps his distance so well. He did I think Ian Garry is such a smart fighter and uh and uh just fights so well that I think he could pull it off, man. I think he can keep distance. I think he's so dangerous on the feet still

claims.claim: Islam Makhachev will likely wrestle Ian Garry to a decision.
claims.quote: I would bet my money on Islam um wrestling him to a decision.

claims.claim: Islam secures takedowns after getting in close.
claims.quote: After he gets in close, I think he secures the takedown.

claims.claim: Islam Makhachev is exceptionally good at timing his takedowns.
claims.quote: He's too good at timing the takedowns.

claims.claim: Once Islam Makhachev gets an opponent down, they are not going to get up.
claims.quote: And if he gets you down, you're you're not going to get up.

claims.claim: Ian Garry's grappling will not be able to handle Islam Makhachev.
claims.quote: I know Ian's grappling is top tier, but I just don't think he can handle Islam.
